第十一章 鬼族兵败
赵天宇脸色一白，以他的修为，如果被困入这个雷网炼狱中，也坚持不到三息就会魂飞魄散，其眼神中顿时露出了惊羡之色。
“兵阵秘术配合天罚神力，威势惊人。如果我赵国有此兵阵秘术，何必龟缩在这不毛之地，受鬼族日日侵犯，大可进军大陆，侵占富足的地方。”赵天宇无奈的遐想着。
雷网收缩，黑雾急速的黯淡了下去，阵阵惨叫渐渐的虚弱了下去，如泣如诉，呜咽悲鸣。
“哧！”黑雾陡然急速的浓缩，一下子缩成了一个篮球大小、黑色的光球，转瞬间又剧烈暴涨。接着“轰”的一声爆裂开来，爆炸的飓风气团撞在了雷网上，雷网一颤，裂开了一道缝隙。
一个拳头大小的黑球一闪，冲出了雷网消失在了迷雾中。
“哪里走！”姜环手掌一挥，一道紫色的闪电如同游龙般的追袭而去，迷雾中听到一声惨叫，呼啸的声音渐渐的消失在远方。
天魂子逃走一丝魂魄，鬼族大部队后面大片迷雾消散，露出了落日沙漠的雪地。
此时，鬼族骑兵混乱后退。姜环没有彻底消灭天魂子，顿时将怒火全部发泄到下面鬼族骑兵身上，手一挥，雷豹骑兵手中长枪飞舞，上面闪出道道电弧，组成了弥天雷网攻击鬼族骑兵。
鬼族，本就惧怕纯阳攻击，雷光正是他们的克星，雷网收缩，如同网鱼一样，鬼族骑兵一波波的被网住，雷豹喷出雷球射杀，时间不大，大批鬼骑化为齑粉，剩余部分鬼族士兵拼命的逃入了落日沙漠，潜入了黑暗区域。
“天宇尊者。派你国大军进入落日沙漠清剿其余孽，我回去禀报父亲后，派人通知鬼帝，通缉此人，竟然祭炼万鬼幡，罪不可赦。另外，
“多谢环少爷，小王记下了，十万块水灵石三个月后准时送到。”赵天宇嘴中苦涩，远远的说了一声，不知道他听到没有。
“奶奶的，灵族也太会赚钱了，出手一次十万块水灵石，金大通听着天空赵王的话，顿时咋舌道。
“老大，水灵石是什么东西？”老九不解道，郭飞也想问，但郭飞向来谨慎，知道问东问西，会让人看不起，所以没有出声。
“我们普通人吃喝拉撒睡，都要靠金币、银币、铜币。但对于修士来说，人家根本不在乎金钱，因此他们交易的是灵石。而且大陆有标准，灵石有一定的大小，按照其品质分为极品、上品、中品、下品四个等级。我们赵国常年和鬼族作战，获得的魂晶，回去融合加工后就可以得到水灵石。数十块魂晶才能合成一块。”金大通解释道。
郭飞听着，怔怔不语。刚才的一幕太震撼了，闪着雷光的坐骑，威风凛凛，遨游九天，这是多么美妙的事情呀！
尤其是那个环少爷指挥雷豹骑兵组成的兵阵，竟然绘成了雷网，让郭飞心神震动。
“灵族，到底是什么样的种族？”这一系列的场景，让郭飞有点接受不了。首先是赵王，想不到修为如此高，竟然可以飞临天空，一斧之威惊天动地。接着又出现了灵族，其掌控雷电之力恍如天神。
在如此神威之下，不得不让人感到自身的渺小。郭飞暗自思忖，自己的尸兵恐怕不敢太暴露，听他们的口气，对可能修炼魔道的修士必定会赶尽杀绝。
尸兵的升级后是尸魔，不知道在这个世界中，会不会被认为就是魔，如果是这样就要异常的谨慎了。

所有梦想都是靠脚踏实地来实现的，郭飞虽然很是震撼、震惊、羡慕，但知道，目前只能一枪一刀拼个立足之地来。
“咚咚咚！”郭飞正在胡思乱想，黑壁上面响起了震天的鼓声。同时，千面旗帜翻飞，一对对骑兵冲入了落日沙漠，接着是步兵和弓箭兵随后紧跟。
“兄弟们，旗语发出来了，让所有部队进入落日沙漠追杀鬼族余孽，我们发财的机会来了。”金大通看着王国亲卫军团在清理战场，将一块块魂晶搜索出来带走，眼中发出了绿光，可是军纪森严，不敢胡来。
清理战场战利品，获得魂晶是亲卫军团的特权，对于他们这些三流预备部队是没有清理战利品的权力的，除非自己杀死的鬼兵，才可以取得魂晶。
“老大，我们带了七日的干粮，敢进入落日沙漠么？”老二提醒道。
“干粮不够可以从死去人身体上取，这是个千载难逢的好机会，只要弄够魂晶，我马上就可以回家了，离家五年了，小英子也该有十六岁了。真想她娘俩呀！”金大通遥望着南方，露出了深深思念。
大家都知道，金大通家中有妻儿，女儿金英，他一天要念叨十几次。这个粗犷魁梧的汉子，心中时常挂念着妻儿。
郭飞眼中微微润湿，这个世界已经没有自己的亲人了，前世的时候父母不和，整日吵架，后来离异，留下的回忆只是伤心。看到金大通的样子，郭飞感到了一丝暖意。
离家几万里，时常想着妻儿的人，这样的人让郭飞感到可敬。
一米深的积雪被骑兵践踏后，堪比硬石，十人没有回黑壁，直接进入落日沙漠追袭鬼族残兵而去。这个时候，已经不分什么兵种建制了，一窝蜂的朝前追袭而去。大部分人的心思是趁火打劫，痛打落水狗，获得魂晶。
进入落日沙漠，越过太阳照不到的地区，郭飞发现，这里没有一丝积雪了，天空的积雪也只下在了落日沙漠太阳光照的区域。只不过这里更加的阴寒，以郭飞的体格，也感到了一阵阴冷。
非但如此，这里还异常的黑暗，看不出多远。前面，几股追袭鬼族的人族士兵因为看不清对方，厮杀了一阵，死伤数人后才发现搞错了。而且，时不时的有骷髅从黑暗中窜出偷袭。
因此，十人更加的小心，缓慢朝前移动。

Chapter 11 The Ghost Clan is Defeated
Zhao Tianyu's face turned pale. With his cultivation level, if he was trapped in this thunder net purgatory, he would be out of his wits within three breaths. A look of surprise suddenly appeared in his eyes.
"The secret art of military formation combined with the power of divine punishment is astonishingly powerful. If our Zhao country had this secret art of military formation, why would we have to huddle in this barren land and be invaded by the ghost tribe every day? We could march into the mainland and occupy the rich places." Zhao Tianyu thought helplessly.
The thunder net shrank, the black mist dimmed rapidly, and the screams gradually became weaker, sobbing and wailing.
"Chi!" The black mist suddenly condensed rapidly, shrinking into a black ball of light the size of a basketball, and then suddenly expanded violently. Then there was a "boom" explosion, and the exploded hurricane air mass hit the thunder net. The thunder net trembled and opened a gap.
A fist-sized black ball flashed out of the thunder net and disappeared into the mist.
"Where to go!" Jiang Huan waved his hand, and a purple lightning bolt chased away like a dragon. A scream was heard in the mist, and the whistling sound gradually disappeared into the distance.
Tian Hunzi escaped with a trace of his soul, and the large fog behind the ghost army dissipated, revealing the snow of the Sunset Desert.
At this time, the ghost cavalry retreated in confusion. Jiang Huan did not completely eliminate Tianhunzi, and immediately vented all his anger on the ghost cavalry below. With a wave of his hand, the spears of the Thunder Leopard cavalry flew in the hands, and arcs flashed from them, forming a sky-high thunder net to attack the ghost cavalry.
The ghost tribe was originally afraid of pure sun attacks, and thunder was their nemesis. The thunder net shrank, like a fish net, and the ghost tribe cavalry were caught in the net in waves. The thunder leopard sprayed out thunder balls to kill them. In a short time, a large number of ghost knights turned into powder. The remaining ghost tribe soldiers desperately fled into the Sunset Desert and sneaked into the dark area.
"Venerable Tianyu, send your country's army into the Sunset Desert to clean up the remaining evildoers. After I went back to report to my father, I sent someone to inform the Ghost Emperor that this person was wanted. He actually sacrificed and refined the Ten Thousand Ghost Flags. His crime is unforgivable. In addition,
"Thank you, Master Huan. Xiao Wang has made a note that one hundred thousand water spirit stones will be delivered on time in three months. "Zhao Tianyu said with bitterness in his mouth from a distance, not sure if he heard it.
"Grandma, the Spirit Tribe is so good at making money. They sell one hundred thousand Water Spirit Stones at a time. Jin Datong was speechless after hearing what King Zhao of the Sky said.
"Boss, what is the Water Spirit Stone?" Lao Jiu asked confused. Guo Fei also wanted to ask, but Guo Fei was always cautious and knew that asking questions would make people look down on him, so he didn't say anything.
"We ordinary people rely on gold coins, silver coins, and copper coins to eat, drink, and sleep. But for monks, they don't care about money at all, so they trade spiritual stones. Moreover, the mainland has standards. Spirit stones have a certain size, and are divided into four grades according to their quality: top grade, top grade, medium grade, and low grade. Our Zhao country has been fighting the ghost tribe all year round, and the soul crystals obtained can be obtained after fusion and processing to obtain water spirit stones. Dozens of soul crystals can be combined into one." Jin Datong explained.
Guo Fei listened and was speechless. The scene just now was so shocking. The mount flashing with lightning was so majestic and soaring through the nine heavens. What a wonderful thing it was!
Especially the formation composed of the Thunder Leopard Cavalry commanded by Young Master Huan was actually drawn into a thunder net, which shocked Guo Fei.
"What kind of race is the Spirit Race?" Guo Fei couldn't accept this series of scenes. The first was King Zhao. He never expected that his cultivation level was so high that he could fly into the sky, and the power of his ax could shake the heavens and the earth. Then came the Eldar, who had the power to control thunder and lightning as if they were gods.
Under such divine power, one has to feel insignificant. Guo Fei secretly thought that his corpse soldiers would not dare to be too exposed. Judging from their tone, they would definitely kill all the monks who might practice the devil's way.
After the zombie soldiers are upgraded, they become zombie demons. I wonder if they will be considered demons in this world. If so,This requires extreme caution.
All dreams are realized by being down-to-earth. Although Guo Fei is shocked, shocked, and envious, he knows that at present, he can only fight to gain a foothold with one shot and one knife.
"Dong dong dong!" Guo Fei was thinking wildly when a loud drum beat sounded from the black wall. At the same time, thousands of flags fluttered, and pairs of cavalry rushed into the Sunset Desert, followed closely by infantry and archers.
"Brothers, the flag has been sent out, let all troops enter the Sunset Desert to hunt down the ghost clan remnants. Here is our chance to make a fortune." Jin Datong looked at the Kingdom's Guards Corps cleaning up the battlefield, searching for pieces of soul crystals and taking them away. Green light shone in his eyes, but the military discipline was strict and he did not dare to act recklessly.
Cleaning up battlefield trophies and obtaining soul crystals is the prerogative of the Guards Corps. For these third-rate reserve troops, they do not have the right to clean up the trophies. Only by killing ghost soldiers can they obtain soul crystals.
"Boss, we have brought seven days of dry food, do we dare to enter the Sunset Desert?" the second brother reminded.
"If you don't have enough dry food, you can get it from the body of the dead. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. As long as I get enough soul crystals, I can go home right away. It has been five years since I left home, and Xiao Yingzi should be sixteen years old. I miss her and my mother so much!" Jin Datong looked to the south with deep longing.
Everyone knows that Jin Datong has a wife and children at home, including his daughter Jin Ying, who he talks about more than ten times a day. This rugged and burly man always thinks about his wife and children.
Guo Fei's eyes were slightly moist. He no longer had any relatives in this world. In his previous life, his parents were at odds and quarreled all day long. Later, they divorced, and the memories left behind were only sad. Seeing Jin Datong's appearance, Guo Fei felt a little warm.
Guo Fei feels respected by people who are thousands of miles away from home and always think about their wives and children.
After being trampled by the cavalry, the one-meter-deep snow was comparable to hard rock. The ten people did not return to the black wall and went directly into the Sunset Desert to pursue the remaining ghost soldiers. At this time, no matter what kind of military structure they were, they swarmed forward to pursue them. Most people's thoughts are to take advantage of the situation, beat up the drowned dog, and obtain the soul crystal.
Entering the Sunset Desert and crossing the area where the sun does not shine, Guo Fei discovered that there was no trace of snow here, and the snow in the sky only fell in the area where the sun shines in the Sunset Desert. It's just that it's even colder here. With Guo Fei's physique, he also felt a chill.
Not only that, it's extremely dark here, and you can't see very far. In the front, several groups of human soldiers who were chasing the ghosts fought for a while because they couldn't see each other clearly. After killing and injuring several people, they realized that they had made a mistake. Moreover, from time to time, skeletons would emerge from the darkness to attack.
Therefore, the ten people were more careful and moved forward slowly.
